description: Every unisafe LP manager (Stable and Volatile) the wallet currently owns, on every chain the Envelop oracle indexes, with the app link for each — the way in when you know the owner and not the managers. Other Envelop wNFTs the wallet holds are left out. An empty list means it owns none; when the oracle cannot answer this is an error, not an empty list.

owner.description: Wallet address that owns the managers (an EOA or a smart account)

name: list_managers
title: Managers a wallet owns
